axiom_policy: CurvedCorpus is core-Lean (no Mathlib); only the three standard core axioms are permitted. sorryAx, Lean.ofReduceBool (native_decide) or any user axiom fails the gate.

theorems.name: CurvedCorpus.trade_colSum_a

nonclaims: acoustic_sum_rule proves only the conservation identity w*(c-c) = 0; no Laplacian or field semantics
gate_rank_identity reduces to the inequality 5p >= 2q on both sides
Narayana/Catalan rows are pinned through k = 6, not k = 8
budget-halting theorems prove the stop condition fires at the cap, not that the loop cannot run away
stationary_unique_uniform holds for integer-valued weight vectors only
no float bounds, statistical significance, forecasting or keep/revert rules are claimed
